interventions.label: Baseline: Actual 1964 Broadcast (Shock at t=30s)
interventions.parameterDescription: Meadow innocence (0-20s) -> Countdown (20-30s) -> Nuclear Detonation (30-45s) -> Mandate (45-60s)

interventions.label: Counterfactual 2A: Cold-Open Detonation (Shock at t=0s, Meadow Last)
interventions.parameterDescription: Places nuclear countdown & blast at t=0s, ending with the quiet meadow counting scene.

interventions.label: Counterfactual 2B: Terminal Detonation (Shock at t=35-60s)
interventions.parameterDescription: Delays the nuclear countdown and fireball to the final frames after the verbal pitch.

interventions.label: Counterfactual 2C: Non-Verbal Shock Attenuation (-60% Audio/Visual Impulse)
interventions.parameterDescription: Preserves identical transcript & stances z(t), but damps nuclear roar (-13.7 -> -25 dBFS) and flash cut (D_JS 0.58 -> 0.04).

perturbations.label: Baseline: Unbroken Oval Office Address (1986)
perturbations.parameterDescription: Single-camera shot (0 cuts), high institutional anchoring, monotonic state convergence.

perturbations.label: Perturbation 3A: De-Institutionalized Framing (A_inst -> 0.05)
perturbations.parameterDescription: Removes statutory/presidential institutional anchoring while keeping speech cadence and stances.

perturbations.label: Perturbation 3B: Early Crisis Critique Injection (t = 30-60s)
perturbations.parameterDescription: Injects 30s of high-energy institutional failure critique early in the speech when inertia is still building.

perturbations.label: Perturbation 3C: Mid-Speech Critique Injection (t = 120-150s)
perturbations.parameterDescription: Injects identical 30s institutional critique at the midpoint of the address.

perturbations.label: Perturbation 3D: Late Speech Critique Injection (t = 210-240s)
perturbations.parameterDescription: Injects identical 30s critique near the end, testing recency impact vs. accumulated institutional inertia.
